'''Rowo's Landing''' was a docking tower on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] that operated during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It was ran by [[Rowo]], a brightly-[[Tattoo/Legends|tattooed]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Gender/Legends|male]].
